channel_dna.platform_type: Text-based social network by Meta. Direct Twitter/X competitor launched July 2023. Connected to Instagram accounts — leverages existing follower graphs.
channel_dna.algorithm_type: Algorithmic feed prioritising engagement (likes, replies, reposts). Early-mover advantage — new accounts get more distribution than on mature platforms. Algorithm still less competitive than Twitter.
channel_dna.primary_audience: Instagram users crossing over — skews younger than Twitter (25-40). Growing creator and business community. Strong overlap with Instagram audience but more text-comfortable.
channel_dna.native_content_formats: Text posts (500 chars), images, short videos, polls, quotes. No link previews in feed (links don't get rich preview treatment yet). Thread format for multi-post stories.
channel_dna.platform_culture_code: More positive and less toxic than Twitter. Lighter, more conversational tone preferred. Still establishing its culture norms — early movers shape the culture. Cross-over from Instagram makes it more lifestyle-comfortable.
channel_dna.account_warmup_requirements: Linked to Instagram — your Instagram followers are auto-suggested to follow you. Instagram audience is your warmup advantage. Accounts with 0 Instagram following start cold.

fit_scoring_matrix.best_product_types: Consumer apps, lifestyle brands, creator economy tools, B2C products with a story to tell, anything where Instagram audience overlaps with product ICP
fit_scoring_matrix.worst_product_types: Pure developer tools (dev community smaller on Threads), enterprise B2B software, highly technical products requiring deep audience
fit_scoring_matrix.best_pricing_models: Freemium and consumer-priced products. Too early for high-ACV B2B deals through Threads.
fit_scoring_matrix.icp_match_signals: Search product category on Threads — if discussion threads exist with 100+ replies, the community is forming. Early signal is more important than size here.
fit_scoring_matrix.red_flags_skip_this_channel: Skip if your ICP has zero Instagram presence. Skip if you need immediate measurable ROI — Threads is still building its commercial ecosystem.
fit_scoring_matrix.geographic_strength: US, Brazil, UK, Australia largest markets. Growing rapidly globally.

growth_mechanics.expected_cac: $0 cash. Early platform advantage means lower effort needed for reach compared to mature platforms.
growth_mechanics.time_to_first_traffic_spike: 1-3 weeks for accounts leveraging existing Instagram following. 4-8 weeks for standalone growth.
growth_mechanics.time_to_first_paying_user: 4-8 weeks. Platform still developing its conversion ecosystem.
growth_mechanics.effort_level: Low-Medium. Less demanding than Twitter in terms of reply culture expectations. 3-5 posts/day for growth.
growth_mechanics.virality_coefficient: Medium and growing. Algorithm is more generous to new content than mature platforms.
growth_mechanics.compounding_potential: Unknown and growing. First-mover advantage is real — building now costs less than building in 2 years.

algorithm_playbook.how_reach_is_determined: Engagement rate (likes, replies, reposts). Early engagement from existing followers signals quality. New accounts get exploration distribution — algorithm surfaces them to relevant users.
algorithm_playbook.what_algorithm_rewards: Posts with genuine replies (not just likes). Content that gets reposted. Consistent posting. Polls and interactive content.
algorithm_playbook.what_kills_reach: External links (don't suppress reach but don't get boosted). Pure promotional content. Cross-posting identical Twitter content (audience detects it and it underperforms).
algorithm_playbook.peak_posting_windows: Similar to Instagram — morning (8-10am), lunch (12-1pm), evening (6-8pm). Still being established by the community.
algorithm_playbook.optimal_posting_cadence: 3-5 posts/day during growth phase. More forgiving than Twitter — less penalty for lower frequency.
algorithm_playbook.content_freshness_window: 24-48 hours. Slightly longer than Twitter but shorter than LinkedIn.

content_system.winning_content_types: 1. Opinions and hot takes (Twitter-style) 2. Personal stories adapted from Instagram 3. Polls 4. Quick tips 5. Questions to the community 6. Behind-the-scenes of building
content_system.hook_formulas: Opinion opener: 'Unpopular opinion: [category conventional wisdom] is completely wrong.' | Question: 'For founders: what is the one thing you wish you had done differently in year one?' | Specific insight: 'After 6 months of building in public, here is what actually moved the needle.'
content_system.platform_native_tone: Lighter and more conversational than LinkedIn, less intense than Twitter. Positive framing performs better than confrontational. Personal, first-person, casual.
content_system.cta_approach: Link in bio (same as Instagram). Threads does not have robust click-through infrastructure yet. Soft CTAs: 'DM me if you want to chat about this.' 'Drop your thoughts below.'
content_system.content_to_avoid: Pure cross-posts from Twitter. Corporate tone. Hard promotional content. Highly political content (Meta actively suppresses this on Threads).
content_system.cross_posting_rules: Instagram Reels cannot be embedded. Text from Twitter needs adaptation (tone shift). LinkedIn content can be lightened and adapted. Threads and Twitter audiences have different expectations.

community_outreach_playbook.where_icp_clusters: Follow hashtags (feature still developing). Search by keyword. Your existing Instagram community is the fastest path — mention Threads in your Instagram Stories to migrate existing followers.
community_outreach_playbook.contribution_before_pitch_rule: Same principle as Twitter — contribute to discussions before promoting product. Threads is small enough that reputation forms quickly.
community_outreach_playbook.dm_outreach_approach: Threads DMs exist but the ecosystem is developing. Instagram DMs still primary for Threads-adjacent outreach.
community_outreach_playbook.influencer_partner_strategy: Instagram influencers who are active on Threads are the primary target — they bridge both audiences. Early adopter creators on Threads have outsized influence as the platform's culture is still forming.
community_outreach_playbook.broadcast_vs_community_mode: More community-oriented than Twitter currently. Conversation and genuine replies valued. Less broadcast-focused.
community_outreach_playbook.banned_behaviours: Same as Instagram/Meta policies. Spam. Fake accounts. Misleading content. Coordinated inauthentic behaviour.

business_stage_playbook.pre_launch_0_users: Build presence now to establish early authority. Share problem research and founder journey. Cross-promote your Threads in Instagram Stories to rapidly build following.
business_stage_playbook.early_traction_1_to_100: Build-in-public content directly translated from Twitter build-in-public format. Threads audience responds well to authentic founder journeys.
business_stage_playbook.growth_100_to_1k: Cross-promote your Threads in Instagram. LinkedIn content adapted for Threads tone. Collaborate with other founders on Threads for mutual audience growth.
business_stage_playbook.scale_1k_plus: Threads Ads expected (follow Meta's ad product roadmap). Threads Newsletter feature in development. Platform is evolving rapidly — stay ahead of new features.

proof_of_play.early_stage_win: Multiple indie founders migrated from Twitter to Threads in 2023-2024 and found significantly easier audience building. Accounts that reached 1K followers on Twitter in 2 years replicated it in 3 months on Threads.
proof_of_play.growth_stage_win: Nike, Netflix, and other major brands established Threads presence early and saw 1M+ followers quickly from Instagram audience conversion.
proof_of_play.what_made_it_work: First-mover advantage. Platform algorithm aggressively surfaced new quality accounts. Instagram follower migration was seamless.
proof_of_play.what_would_have_killed_it: Waiting 2 years before joining — the early-mover advantage window is real and closing.
